ls1.title: LS1 High Bay Series
ls1.scope: Staging Areas, Loading Docks, & Open Stacks
ls1.description: Integrated High-Area Optimization: Uniform, high-output lighting designed for high-traffic, open floor plans.

rh1.title: RH1 High Bay Series
rh1.description: Three-Pathway Optical Design: Downward, vertical, and uplight distribution brightens walls and racks, and reduces glare.

energy.title: Up to 50% Lower Energy
energy.text: Precision optics and non-relay dimming slash kWh without sacrificing output.

maintenance.title: Less Maintenance
maintenance.text: Sealed housings and 100,000-hour LEDs remove ladders from your OpEx.

visibility.title: Better Visibility
visibility.text: Higher CRI and uniformity improve accuracy, safety, and worker comfort.

glare.title: Reduced Glare
glare.text: Patented reflectors deliver crisp light where you need it — nowhere else.

installation.title: Faster Installation
installation.text: Lightweight fixtures and pre-configured mounts cut labor hours in half.

roi.title: Higher ROI
roi.text: Most facilities see payback in 18 months — often faster with rebates.

comparison.title: A different class of industrial LED.
comparison.text: We build our fixtures — optics, driver, dimming — in-house. The result is measurably better performance than off-the-shelf commercial LED.

optical.title: Superior Optical Distribution

driver.title: Driver Technology
driver.text: Silent, non-relay dimming with steady, flicker-free output.
